entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Information element used to convey EAP messages such as EAP-failure within authentication procedures.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Authentication procedure message that can carry the EAP message IE to convey EAP-failure.

entities.name: EAP-failure message conveyed
entities.description: Condition where the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is used to convey an EAP-failure message.

relations.description: The AUTHENTICATION REJECT message contains the EAP message IE when conveying EAP-failure.
The presence of the EAP message IE in AUTHENTICATION REJECT is guarded by the condition that it is used to convey EAP-failure.
